# Kevin Gámez

> Founding engineer based in Bogotá, Colombia, looking for the next thing. Most recently founding engineer at Enttor (Mar 2025 - Jul 2026), a MaC Venture Capital-backed startup in New York, worked remotely. M.Sc. Information Engineering at Universidad de los Andes. Builds in TypeScript and Python.

## Identity

- **Full name:** Kevin Gámez
- **Role:** Founding Engineer
- **Status:** Open to founding-engineer roles

- **Location:** Bogotá, Colombia (UTC-5)
- **Languages:** Spanish (native), English (professional)
- **Education:** M.Sc. Information Engineering (Jan 2024 - May 2025) and B.Sc. Systems and Computing (Jan 2019 - Dec 2023), both at Universidad de los Andes. Minors in Mathematics and Management (Dec 2022).

## Most recent role (Enttor, Mar 2025 - Jul 2026)

Owned engineering on a six-person team across several pivots, and built three products end to end. It started as an outbound engine, browser agents sourcing prospects on Instagram and LinkedIn and drafting the DMs. It ended as a multi-tenant paid-ads platform putting Meta and TikTok campaign data on one metric schema, a Slack agent media buyers drive in plain language across 165 tools, and an AI ad studio that generates ads from a brand URL and makes them editable again as layers on GPU workers (ad generation went from an hour to under 5 minutes).

Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase, Postgres with row level security, Playwright, Claude, Python on Modal

## Past

- **Samsam** (Feb 2024 - Mar 2025), product engineer at a Neo-backed e-commerce marketplace. Shipped both sides: a React Native and Expo shopper app and a Next.js merchant dashboard, on NestJS services with Prisma and Postgres.
- **Heinsohn Human Global Solutions** (Oct 2022 - Dec 2023), software engineer on HR and payroll software. Moved deploys to Azure with CI/CD to every client server, owned a Python and Flask reporting service, built the Power BI dashboards clients used for headcount, turnover and payroll cost.
- **B.Sc. thesis** (Dec 2023): deep learning for crop segmentation on satellite imagery. DeepLab V3+ in PyTorch on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data, 98.4% accuracy and 0.991 F1.

## Selected work

- **AI Ad Studio**: give it a brand's website and it writes ad concepts with Claude, renders them, checks its own work, then takes finished ads apart into editable layers. Next.js, Python, PyTorch, Modal, Supabase.
- **Slack Agent**: a Slack bot media buyers talk to like a coworker, 165 tools across the Meta and TikTok ad APIs, with a router that narrows each message to a shortlist. Claude tool use, pgvector.
- **Enttor Platform**: prospect sourcing and outreach, later refocused on paid ads with Meta and TikTok insights on one metric schema. Next.js, Supabase, Postgres RLS.
- **MakeMotionGraphics**: text to looping motion graphics. Claude writes an HTML scene, screenshots it to check its own output, and records it to MP4. Puppeteer, ffmpeg.
- **LinkedIn Editor**: a chat-first editor for LinkedIn posts, grounded by search over posts that performed. pgvector RAG, Next.js.
- **Browser Automation Infrastructure**: Node services keeping authenticated browser sessions alive for outreach. Kevin contributed the Instagram pipeline and session handling. Playwright, Redis, Postgres.

content, noindex), /lab/ (unlisted rendering experiments) and /api/ (route
handlers, no prose).
